description: PLA campaigns competing in a product category for ONE period. Each row is a campaign (merchant + os_client_id + campaign_id) within a category (category_l1/l2/l3), with its campaign-group name, status, campaign_subtype, per-campaign daily budget, derived bidding_strategy_type (CPC / CPM / Max Performance CPC/CPM / ROI / Fixed CPM / CPD / NA / UNKNOWN), and category-level currency-converted spend, CPC and CPM. Filter by category_l1/l2/l3 (and/or os_client_id / campaign_id) to scope to one category. Called once per period; run current + baseline to compare.

bidding_strategy_type.selector: CASE WHEN (mcd.campaign_type = 'PERFORMANCE' AND mcd.objective_name IN ('Visitors', 'Visibility') AND mcd.bidding_strategy = 'AUTO_CPC') THEN 'Max Performance CPC' WHEN (mcd.campaign_type = 'PERFORMANCE' AND mcd.objective_name IN ('Visitors', 'Visibility') AND mcd.bidding_strategy = 'AUTO_CPM') THEN 'Max Performance CPM' WHEN (mcd.campaign_type = 'PERFORMANCE' AND mcd.objective_name IN ('Visitors', 'Visibility') AND mcd.bidding_strategy IN ('CPM', 'CPC')) THEN mcd.bidding_strategy WHEN mcd.campaign_type IN ('INVENTORY', 'AWARENESS') AND mcd.campaign_subtype = 'PRE_AUCTION' THEN 'NA' WHEN mcd.objective_name IN ('Absolute Revenue') THEN 'ROI' WHEN mcd.objective_name IN ('Visibility', 'Reach') AND mcd.campaign_subtype = 'AUCTION' THEN UPPER(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(REPLACE(mcd.campaign_setting_metadata, '""', '"'), '$.bidding_strategy_type')) WHEN mcd.objective_name IN ('Visibility', 'Reach') AND mcd.campaign_subtype = 'BLOCK_BUY' AND JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(REPLACE(mcd.campaign_setting_metadata, '""', '"'), '$.bidding_strategy_type') = 'CPM' THEN 'Fixed CPM' WHEN mcd.objective_name IN ('Visibility', 'Reach') AND mcd.campaign_subtype = 'BLOCK_BUY' AND JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(REPLACE(mcd.campaign_setting_metadata, '""', '"'), '$.bidding_strategy_type') = 'CPD' THEN 'CPD' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END

spend.description: Category-level ad spend for the campaign over the period, converted to the marketplace currency.

cpc.selector: ROUND(CASE WHEN SUM(cte.clicks) > 0 THEN SUM(cte.cost) / SUM(cte.clicks) ELSE 0 END, 2)

cpm.selector: ROUND(CASE WHEN SUM(cte.impressions) > 0 THEN (SUM(cte.cost) * 1000) / SUM(cte.impressions) ELSE 0 END, 2)

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM (SELECT opacrp_raw.merchant_id, opacrp_raw.client_id, opacrp_raw.marketing_campaign_id, opacrp_raw.category_l1, opacrp_raw.category_l2, opacrp_raw.category_l3, SUM(opacrp_raw.cost * scc.conversion_factor) AS cost, SUM(opacrp_raw.clicks) AS clicks, SUM(opacrp_raw.impressions) AS impressions FROM reporting.os_product_ads_campaign_category_report_pla AS opacrp_raw INNER JOIN reporting.agencies AS agencies ON agencies.marketplace_client_id = opacrp_raw.marketplace_client_id LEFT JOIN reporting.static_currency_conversion AS scc ON scc.from_currency = 'USD' AND scc.to_currency = agencies.currency WHERE agencies.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND opacrp_raw.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' GROUP BY opacrp_raw.merchant_id, opacrp_raw.client_id, opacrp_raw.marketing_campaign_id, opacrp_raw.category_l1, opacrp_raw.category_l2, opacrp_raw.category_l3 HAVING SUM(opacrp_raw.product_count) > 0 OR SUM(opacrp_raw.cost) > 0) AS cte INNER JOIN reporting.marketing_campaign_dimensions AS mcd ON mcd.client_id = cte.client_id AND mcd.marketing_campaign_id = cte.marketing_campaign_id INNER JOIN reporting.marketing_campaign_group_dimensions AS mcgd ON mcgd.client_id = cte.client_id AND mcgd.marketing_campaign_group_id = mcd.marketing_campaign_group_id INNER JOIN reporting.monetize_merchant_dimensions AS mmd ON LOWER(mmd.merchant_id) = LOWER(cte.merchant_id) AND mmd.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' WHERE mmd.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND (mcd.campaign_origin != 'PACKAGE_BASED' OR mcd.campaign_origin IS NULL) AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__ ORDER BY __ATTRIBUTES_ORDER_BY__ LIMIT __LIMIT__ OFFSET __OFFSET__;
